name: Tiger Mastery
summary: At Nesingwary's Expedition in northern Stranglethorn Vale, Ajeck Rouack sends you to hunt mature tigers. After you defeat young stalkers, she sets you against ten mature Stranglethorn Tigers.

sections.title: Hunting the Mature Cats
sections.body: Ajeck Rouack sends you to hunt ten mature Stranglethorn Tigers. Your success against younger predators has brought you to a harder test in the wilds of Stranglethorn Vale. Greater challenges lie beyond this hunt.

faq.answer: Ajeck Rouack, a hunter at Nesingwary's Expedition in northern Stranglethorn Vale, assigns the hunt.

faq.q: What beasts are you tasked with hunting?
faq.answer: You are sent to track and slay ten mature Stranglethorn Tigers in the surrounding jungle.

faq.q: Where does this trial fit in the hunt?
faq.answer: This hunt follows your first Tiger Mastery trial and leads to a third stage under Ajeck Rouack's guidance.
